create_Colorcal_module: create a Colorcal module initialized with a list of cameras for per-camera color calibration
run_Colorcal_forward: run the Colorcal forward pass on an image tensor with a camera index to calibrate colors
review_Colorcal_forward_conv2d: review the Colorcal forward method that uses grouped conv2d for per-channel color calibration
summarize_Colorcal_class: summarize the Colorcal class that learns per-camera weight and bias parameters for color calibration
test_Colorcal_parameters: test the Colorcal parameters method that yields only trainable parameters with requires_grad enabled
